decisions.reason: GA4 remains the only Google Analytics standard, so shop clients still need a GA4 tracking plugin, and it supports the firm's analytics and conversion services.
Linking shops to retail and merchandise management systems is a lasting need that uses the firm's interface development skills and keeps client relationships going.
Relaunch SEO support costs little to offer, ties directly into the firm's core shop relaunch projects, and is still marketed on its own page.
The recently launched SEO workshops build on the firm's existing marketing expertise at low cost and can lead clients into larger engagements, so they should get time to prove themselves.
